tables.label: Table 1
tables.caption: Properties of GL13 peptides.
footnotes: Sequences shown in single letter code. L-amino acids are shown as upper case letters; D-amino acids are shown in lower case letters. Molecular weight (MW) and Net charge at pH 7 were calculated using the PepCalc calculator from Innovagen (pepcalc.com).

tables.label: Table 2
tables.caption: Minimal inhibitory concentrations.
footnotes: P. aeruginosa Xen 41, S. aureus Xen 36 and S. aureus USA300 (MRSA) were tested against LGL13K, DGL13K and polymyxin B. Median MIC values were calculated from MIC curves based on 4–7 (P. aeruginosa Xen41); 3–5 (S. aureus Xen36) or 1–2 (S. aureus USA300) independent experiments (N as listed). > indicates that MIC was above the tested peptide concentration range.
